summary: __thiscall scene-file light parser. Reads lines from the scene buffer a3 via LineReaderFromBuffer; on each non-comment line it fetches the Type token and parses View, Dir, Color, Range, Intensity and Active values with the PRNG/float helpers. Maps the Type string to a light kind code v7 (Directional=1, StaticOmni=4, MovingOmni=2), creates the scene node via sub_545430 (returns -1 on failure), applies the parsed values through directional or omnidirectional setter paths, then pushes color/intensity into UI property slots and toggles the Active flag. Returns 0 on success.

operations.description: Initialize parser state: v7 (light kind code) = 0, v4 (active flag, default true) = 1, all output locals zeroed, default range v11 = 1120403456, default intensity v18[0] = 1.0.
Store the this pointer into the stack scratch slot v18[1] (LODWORD(v18[1]) = this); decompiler artifact reused as a float slot later.
Loop while LineReaderFromBuffer(v3) != 1, i.e. until the line reader signals no more lines.
Break out of the read loop when the token type at *v3 equals 3; skip the token block when *v3 equals 2.
Fetch the Type token string into v20 via sub_559E20(v3, aType, v20, 0).
Parse four float values for the View entry off_5DC230 into v10/v9/v8 via PRNG4UniformFloatsFromSeed.
Parse the Dir (direction) floats into v14/v13/v12 via PRNG4UniformFloatsFromSeed(v3, aDir, ...).
Parse the Color token into packed integer slots v15/v16/v17 via sub_559F00(v3, aColor, ...).
Parse the Range token into v19 and v11 via PRNG4UniformFloatsFromSeed(v3, aRange, ...).
Parse the Intensity token into v18 via PRNG4UniformFloatsFromSeed(v3, aIntensity, ...).
If sub_559E20(v3, aActive, v21, 0) finds an Active token, set v4=1 when v21 equals the 'true' string or v4=0 when v21 equals the 'false' string.
Map the Type string to a light kind code: 'Directional' -> v7=1, 'StaticOmni' -> v7=4, 'MovingOmni' -> v7=2.
Create the scene node with kind code v7 by calling sub_545430((int*)&a3, a2, v7); if it returns non-zero, return -1 immediately.
For a directional light (v7==1), apply the parsed direction via sub_55D460(v14, v13, v12).
For omnidirectional lights (v7==2 or v7==4), apply the View values through SetUIPropertyGroupWithChainUpdate(v10, v9, v8) and push the range via StateFieldSetterWithGlobalDirtyFlag(v11).
Extract the packed color (v17 | ((v16 | (v15 << 8)) << 8)) into a channel via ByteExtractionFromUint(2, ...).
Publish the intensity to three UI property slots: UIPropertyValueSetter(1, v18[0]), UIPropertyValueSetter(2, v18[0]), UIPropertyValueSetter(3, v18[0]).
Toggle the light active state via BitFlagSetterWithDXUpdate(v4).
Return 0 on success; -1 when node creation sub_545430 fails.

unresolved: Global string names (aType, aDir, aColor, aRange, aIntensity, aActive, aTrue, aFalse, directional/staticomni/movingomni) come from the DERIVED analysis layer; the exact token text is not visible in the packet's raw source.
Meaning of the token-type codes 2 and 3 in *v3 (comment/end markers) is inferred from control flow only.
The exact semantics of sub_545430's return and the role of a2 (scene context) are not established.
Which member the UI property setters and BitFlagSetterWithDXUpdate address (the light object vs the scene UI context) is unproven.
The View/off_5DC230 value set appears redundant with the SetUIPropertyGroupWithChainUpdate path; whether it feeds a different object is unknown.
